ai_overview.visible_text:
Experiment Beauty’s Super Saturated Serum delivers elite, heavyweight hydration with a unique, stringy texture and stellar price-to-size value.
Hydration
30% glycerin formula: Acts as a powerful humectant that pulls water deep into the skin.
Instant plumping: Polyglutamic acid locks moisture on the surface for an immediate dewy glow.
Clinical backing: Independent trials show a 96% instant increase in skin hydration.
Sephora
+2
Texture
Gooey and stretchy: Reminds many users of snail mucin.
Tacky finish: Leaves a slight grip on the skin that works well as a makeup primer.
Quick absorption: Melts in fast despite the initial thick look.
TikTok
·kellymengg
+3
Value
Generous sizing: Retails around $26 to $28 for 1.35 oz (40 ml), which is larger than the standard 1 oz serum size.
Refillable: Offers cheaper refill pods to cut down on waste and cost over time.
Community consensus: Users on SkinSort praise its performance, though opinions on the tacky finish are mixed.
